locator: PDF p. 3 (printed p.467), paragraph beginning It is worth noting
interpretation: Paraphrase preserves explanatory versus purely modal distinction; no claim that the support models are genuine full grounds.
attribution: The passage states a necessary target truth can have merely partial grounds even though its proposition is modally entailed by the propositions corresponding to those grounds; modal entailment alone does not distinguish full from partial grounding, which is the premise.
